about: Reference player profiles for the pacing checker (tools/lang/pacing.py) and as starting presets for the level check. words: a word is known if its JLPT level >= jlpt (5 = N5 only) and, when freq is set, its frequency rank <= freq; or if its rank <= freq_any; plus known, minus unknown (surface or dictionary form). kanji: band 0-3 as in game/notes/day1-design.md (0 all hidden; 1 N5 learning; 2 N5 readable, N4 learning; 3 N5+N4 readable, rest learning), then readable/learning/hidden lists override per kanji; readable_jlpt makes every kanji at that level or easier readable. grammar: known ids from grammar.json, or all points with level >= known_level.

grammar.note: Quiz: particles で/に/が, 〜たい, 〜てください OK. Missed でした, ことがある, 〜やすい, 〜ている+から, 〜ても, relative clauses. Casual past, ないで, けど and explanatory の are treated as not yet solid.
